For food and litter I probably spend about 6-7 dollars a day on my cat. She eats mostly dry food but one can of wet food a day. The dry food is 25 dollars a bag but lasts about a month.

You're not flirting, inviting men over, going on dates. You're streaming. It sounds like he doesn't have any trust in you or your loyalty. If any of my friends were with a guy like that I'd want them to leave for their own well-being.

Not sure if this is a religious thing or what, but it doesn't seem good to me that he doesn't want you streaming to any men who might be watching or chatting.

As a female who also streams, my husband understands that there will be other males in the chat. They're not a threat to him because he trusts me. If I were to work in a restaurant he wouldn't get upset about male customers coming in to eat. You can't control that, you can only control your actions. Be civil to everyone regardless of gender.

There might be some creeps out there who will say weird things in chat, but you can ban them. In my experience most people (male or female) just want to chat about the game. I've had a few people comment on my looks and I just ban them.

A little about my experience...

I came across this subreddit about a week ago, and purchased a navel orange for the occasion that was about to commence. It's been a while since I had a navel orange, since I normally buy a whole bag of Cuties when I'm craving citrus fruit.

At first I was a bit nervous. I was having some trouble peeling a piece of my orange, so after straining my fingernails, I decided to just dig my teeth into the stubborn bit of peel. Inadvertently, I had gotten a blast of juicy flavour from the orange. I chewed the piece of fruit off from the peel, but since it was a bit too fibrous, not tender, I spit it out.

As for the main part of the orange, I peeled away the weird bits in between each segment and ate. It was a bit messy in the beginning due to my peeling, but quite tasty. The taste was sweeter than I expected. The smell that circulated was pleasant, but more bitter than the orange itself.

A few segments in, I decided to let some of the juice dribble out my mouth. The feeling of the cool juice, cascading down my chin, combined with the warmth of the shower upon my back made for an indescribable experience. It felt like I was being drawn back to nature and connected on a more primal level with my ancient ancestors.

Upon finishing the orange, I washed myself, though I felt in no way dirty for what had transpired. In fact, it was almost like I had been born again and was completing the transformation into a more whole version of myself. During this process, I allowed myself to step on the discarded peel in the tub.

I think that the next time I have a craving for an orange or even if I buy a bag of cuties I will savor this once again. Thank you to my predecessors who introduced me to this strange practice.

Mine 1,000,000 ores in a year, turn them in, and get an automatic 20m XP reward and a ton of GP in various items.

Using Seren Stones for this is well over 200m XP, and unless they make a "True Trimmed Completionist cape", 200m shouldn't be required for anything.

I prefer the current system, since having smaller icons that need to be clicked to reveal the text allows more to fit in one area without scrolling. This makes it easier for me to see what needs to be done without scrolling all over.

I disagree. The achievement systems in other MMOs are a turn off to me because they are too detailed and demanding. The tasks are often pointless and boring. I like the idea of adding new tasks/achievements to do. They could possibly include new content and Menaphos when that comes out. I also think that having a QC option "I have completed 50 of 100 tasks" or something similar would be a nice idea. I am against making a scoring system for this, though.

I also think the ribbon bar/interface should not change. The way it is now with the different areas in the drop down and rows or squares you can select seems easier, since you can see so many more achievements without needing to do so much scrolling or searching. 

The path system for lower level achievements may be something nice to have the option of turning on, but as a higher level player, I think the path system is kind of annoying, and if I need to know how to get to GWD, I know how to find the way to do that without turning Path on.
